name: vj5xv5-session-rules
goal: Record incident rules once in the signed Tracker journal, then verify that later Claude and Codex launches and Hub read the updated rules without restarting Tracker.

evidence: Native launch guidance is compiled into trackerHostBrief and only changes with a release. Credential hunting, orphan tabs, oversized log reads and local model load exposed the lack of a replicated runtime rule source.

Extend the installed CLI/native journal and launcher coverage from static brief strings to a live incident append, replicated reads and fresh launch instructions. Extend private Hub overview coverage for recent entries.
